clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, Long Wash runs south from Auberdine toward Ameth'Aran beneath a gray sky. Murlocs now make its shore dangerous.

Long Wash is Darkshore's shortest distinct stretch of coast, despite its name. Beneath the region's perpetual overcast skies, damp sand lies strewn with flotsam, driftwood, and sea creatures washed up by the Veiled Sea. Crabs comb the surf, but travelers heading south from Auberdine must watch for murloc tribes camped along the water's edge. The murlocs attack anyone who enters the territory where they scavenge.
